metadata.question: On February 14, 2023, were nighttime lights in central Antakya, the capital of Türkiye’s Hatay Province, brighter than those around Hatay Airport?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) data - Date: February 14, 2023 - Two locations: Central Antakya (city center) vs. Hatay Airport area - Need to define geometries for both locations 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS DNB data doesn't need cloud masking for nighttime lights - May need to filter for nighttime observations only - Check for data availability on this specific date 3. Logic: - Compare mean radiance values between the two areas - Valid Zero: If radiance is 0, it's a valid measurement (no lights) - C1: If no images found for Feb 14, 2023 - C2: If no valid pixels after processing - C3: If result is None/NaN - A: If central Antakya is brighter (higher radiance) - B: If Hatay Airport area is brighter or equal ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometries for central Antakya and Hatay Airport // Antakya city center (approximate coordinates) const antakyaCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([36.1578, 36.2069]).buffer(2000); // Hatay Airport area (approximate coordinates) const hatayAirport = ee.Geometry.Point([36.3628, 36.3628]).buffer(2000); // Date range for February 14, 2023 const startDate = '2023-02-14'; const endDate = '2023-02-15'; // Load VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band data const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); // Check if monthly data exists, if not try daily data let viirsSize = viirs.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Monthly VIIRS images found: ${viirsSize}`); if (viirsSize === 0) { // Try daily data instead const viirsDaily = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); viirsSize = viirsDaily.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Daily VIIRS images found: ${viirsSize}`); if (viirsSize === 0) { console.log('No VIIRS data available for February 14, 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Use daily data const img = viirsDaily.first(); // Calculate mean radiance for both areas const antakyaStats = img.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: antakyaCenter, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const airportStats = img.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: hatayAirport, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const antakyaRad = antakyaStats.get('avg_rad_mean').getInfo(); const antakyaCount = antakyaStats.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); const airportRad = airportStats.get('avg_rad_mean').getInfo(); const airportCount = airportStats.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Antakya Center - Radiance: ${antakyaRad}, Pixels: ${antakyaCount}`); console.log(`Hatay Airport - Radiance: ${airportRad}, Pixels: ${airportCount}`); // Check for invalid data if (antakyaCount === 0 || airportCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in one or both areas'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (antakyaRad === null || airportRad === null || isNaN(antakyaRad) || isNaN(airportRad)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare radiance values if (antakyaRad > airportRad) { console.log('Central Antakya is brighter than Hatay Airport area'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Hatay Airport area is brighter or equal to central Antakya'); console.log('B'); } } else { // Use monthly data const img = viirs.first(); const antakyaStats = img.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: antakyaCenter, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const airportStats = img.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: hatayAirport, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const antakyaRad = antakyaStats.get('avg_rad_mean').getInfo(); const antakyaCount = antakyaStats.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); const airportRad = airportStats.get('avg_rad_mean').getInfo(); const airportCount = airportStats.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Antakya Center - Radiance: ${antakyaRad}, Pixels: ${antakyaCount}`); console.log(`Hatay Airport - Radiance: ${airportRad}, Pixels: ${airportCount}`); if (antakyaCount === 0 || airportCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in one or both areas'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (antakyaRad === null || airportRad === null || isNaN(antakyaRad) || isNaN(airportRad)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (antakyaRad > airportRad) { console.log('Central Antakya is brighter than Hatay Airport area'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Hatay Airport area is brighter or equal to central Antakya'); console.log('B'); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
